title: [BUG] Concurrent sessions in one working tree: a stale git index silently deletes and reverts another session's committed work
outputText: one repo one branch two sessions; B seeds private GIT_INDEX_FILE and stages one file; A stages different paths and commits; B commits → A's adds arrive as deletions, A's mods revert; exit 0, no conflict, no prompt; D a.txt, A b.txt, M shared.txt (shared back to v1); shared index staging deletion of a file that exists on disk
